III. 1. 120</ls>] .²1 What should or ought to be done, right, proper, fit; साधु पर्याप्तमेतावत्कृत्यश्चारित्रसंग्रहः <ls>Rām. 7. 13. 18</ls>. .²2 Feasible, practicable. .²3 One who may be seduced from allegiance, treacherous; <ls>Rāj. T. 5. 247</ls>. .{@-त्यम्@} .²1 What ought to be done, duty, (इतिकृत्य) function; <ls>Ms. 2. 237</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 67</ls>. .²2 Work, business, deed, commission; बन्धुकृत्यम् <ls>Me. 116</ls>; अन्योन्यकृत्यैः <ls>Ś. 7. 34</ls>. .²3 Purpose, object, end; कूजद्भिरापादितवंशकृत्यम् <ls>R. 2. 12</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 15</ls>. .²4 Motive, cause; किमागमनकृत्यं ते देवगन्धर्वसेवित <ls>Rām. 7. 21. 4</ls>. .{@-त्यः@} A class of affixes used to form potential (future) passive participle; these are तव्य, अनीय, य and also एलिम. .{@-त्या@} .²1 Action, deed. .²2 Magic. .²3 A female deity to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive and magical purposes; परं यत्नमकरोद्यो मे पापकृत्यां शमयेदिति <ls>Mb. 1. 31. 11</ls>.
